rules.name: A Thousand Willing Voices
rules.description: A friendly non-Daemon Emperor's Children Character without Psyker can perform **one Lesser Daemonic Ritual per turn** as though it were Psyker LEVEL 1, solely for that ritual. A friendly non-Daemon Emperor's Children Psyker Character can perform **one additional Lesser Daemonic Ritual per turn** without spending its psychic-level allowance.

rules.name: Unique: DAEMON
rules.description: Your army can include one Unique: DAEMON detachment.

rules.name: Experimental Augmentation
rules.description:
Once per battle round in your Command phase, each friendly Emperor's Children Chirurgeon model can select one friendly Emperor's Children Infantry unit within 6" that contains a non-Character model. Destroy one non-Character model in that unit, then give it one Surgical Augmentation. Each unit can receive one augmentation per battle. It lasts until the end of the battle.

- **Ossified Carapace:** Add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of models in this unit.
- **Redundant Musculature:** Once per phase, when an enemy unit targets this unit with attacks, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of its attacks against this unit until it finishes attacking, to a minimum of 1.
- **Serrated Bone Grafts:** This unit's melee weapons have Anti-Infantry 4+.
- **Volatile Organ Implants:** Each time a model in this unit is destroyed, roll one D6 before removing it. On a 4+, each enemy unit within 2" of that model suffers 1 mortal wound.
- **Neural Disruptors:** Subtract 1 from Battle-shock tests taken by enemy units within 6" of this unit.

rules.name: Surgical Conditioning
rules.description: Once per battle round, when a friendly Emperor's Children unit with a Surgical Augmentation within 6" of a friendly Chirurgeon must take a Leadership test for Fading Euphoria or Pain Brings Clarity, you can destroy one non-Character model in that unit. If you do, choose whether it automatically passes or fails that test.

rules.name: Resonant Minds
rules.description: Once per battle round, each friendly EC or Legions of Excess Psyker unit can use one Level 1 psychic power without consuming its psychic-level allowance.

rules.name: Cacophony of Steel
rules.description: After a friendly Emperor's Children Vehicle unit shoots, select one enemy unit hit by its attacks. That unit takes a Battle-shock test with a −1 modifier and subtracts 1 from Hit rolls until the start of your next Shooting phase. Each enemy unit takes at most one test from this ability per battle round.

rules.name: The Killing Sequence
rules.description: Once per Fight phase, after a friendly Emperor's Children unit finishes fighting and its melee attacks inflicted damage, select one other friendly Emperor's Children unit within 6" that is eligible to fight and has not fought this phase. That unit fights immediately.

rules.name: Never Still
rules.description: Add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls for friendly Emperor's Children units. Friendly Emperor's Children Infantry, Mounted and Beast units are Mercurial units. Once per battle round, after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 8" of an unengaged Mercurial unit, you can select one such Mercurial unit to make a Normal move of D3+3".

rules.name: Pledges to the Dark Prince
rules.description:
At the start of the battle round, if your Warlord is on the battlefield, pledge how many enemy units you will destroy this round. At the end of the round, if you met or exceeded your pledge, gain Pact points equal to your pledge. Otherwise, your Warlord suffers D3 mortal wounds. Your Emperor's Children units gain the following cumulative bonuses: 

**1+ Pact:** Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. 

**3+ Pact:** Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. 

**5+ Pact:** Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [LETHAL HITS] and [SUSTAINED HITS 1] abilities. 

**7+ Pact:** Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+.

rules.name: Daemonic Communion
rules.description:
Friendly Emperor's Children and Legions of Excess units are Empowered while within 6" of one another.

**Blood for the Dark Prince**
After an Empowered Emperor's Children unit destroys an enemy unit, select one friendly Legions of Excess unit within 6" of it. The next time the selected unit fights, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons until the end of the phase.

**Ecstatic Slaughter**
After an Empowered Legions of Excess unit destroys an enemy unit, select one friendly Emperor's Children unit within 6" of it. The next time the selected unit fights, add 1 to Wound rolls for its melee attacks until the end of the phase.

Repeated uses of the same ability do not stack.

rules.name: The Performance Eternal
rules.description:
**Cast the Performers.** At the start of your first Command phase, select three different friendly Emperor's Children units on the battlefield. Designate one **the Duellist**, one **the Dancer** and one **the Executioner**. Select one role to hold **the Spotlight**. Each role can earn no more than one **Ovation** per battle round. **Ovation triggers:** - **Duellist:** During the Fight phase, its melee attacks inflict damage on a CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, and the Duellist survives until the end of that phase. If the enemy army has no surviving CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE units, damaging any enemy unit in melee qualifies. - **Dancer:** In your Charge phase, it completes a Charge move ending within range of an objective marker you did **not** control immediately before it began that Charge move. - **Executioner:** Its attacks destroy an enemy unit. **Spotlight:** Immediately after a Performer earns an Ovation, its role takes the Spotlight until another role earns it or a rule transfers it. **Replacement:** At the start of your next Command phase after a Performer is destroyed or permanently leaves the battlefield, assign its role to an eligible unit without a role, if possible. The role retains its Spotlight and Ovations, even while vacant. A returning Performer loses its role if replaced. **The Three Acts:** Your army begins in **Act I**. At the end of a battle round, check for advancement. The new Act replaces the previous Act at the start of the next battle round. **Act I — The Opening Flourish**
**Army:** Add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in friendly Emperor's Children units.
**Spotlight:** Re-roll Charge rolls for the Performer holding the Spotlight.
**Advance to Act II:** During the same battle round, two **different** Performer roles each earned an Ovation. **Act II — The Rapturous Climax**
**Army:** Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in friendly Emperor's Children units during a turn in which their unit made a Charge move.
**Spotlight:** The Performer holding the Spotlight has FIGHTS FIRST.
**Advance to Act III:** Since entering Act II, all **three** roles have earned at least one Ovation, and the Performer holding the Spotlight destroyed at least one enemy unit with its attacks while Act II was active. **Act III — The Grand Finale**
**Army:** Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic and improve the Armour Penetration characteristic by 1 of melee weapons equipped by models in friendly Emperor's Children units.
**Spotlight:** Once per battle round, immediately after the Performer holding the Spotlight finishes fighting, if that unit is still on the battlefield, it can make a Pile-in move of up to 6" and **fight one additional time**, provided it is then eligible to fight.

rules.name: Whispers of the Dark Prince
rules.description:
At the start of each phase, you can offer a Seduction to one unit within 12" of a friendly Emperor's Children unit. You can choose an enemy unit in either player's turn or a friendly Emperor's Children unit in your turn. If the target is at Level 0, choose a Seduction for it. A unit keeps its Seduction until it returns to Level 0.

**Deepening Temptation**
At the start of each player's Command phase, automatically offer a Seduction to each eligible unit that player controls at Level I or higher, regardless of range.

**Accepting and resisting**
A friendly Emperor's Children unit always accepts and can reach only Level II. An enemy unit can reach Level III. An offer to a unit at its maximum Level has no effect.

- **Accept:** Increase the unit's Level by one. If it reaches Level III, it takes a Battle-shock test with a −1 modifier.
- **Resist at Level 0:** The unit's controller can decline without rolling.
- **Resist at Level I or II:** Roll one D6. A roll of 5+ resists Level II and a roll of 6+ resists Level III. On a success, reduce the unit's Level by one and subtract 1 from its next Battle-shock test this battle round. On a failure, increase its Level by one. If it reaches Level III this way, it suffers 3 mortal wounds.

Apply all Boons and Prices from the unit's current Level and each lower Level.

**Rapture of Speed**
- **I — Boon:** Add 2" to the unit's Move characteristic. **Price:** It cannot Fall Back.
- **II — Boon:** It can declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced. **Price:** Subtract 1 from Hit rolls for its ranged attacks.
- **III — Boon:** Add 2" to the unit's Move characteristic. It can re-roll Charge rolls. **Price:** Before it declares a charge, it takes a Leadership test. On a failure, the Emperor's Children player chooses a legal charge target. If none is eligible, the unit cannot charge.

**Exquisite Agony**
- **I — Boon:** Feel No Pain 6+. **Price:** Worsen Leadership by 1.
- **II — Boon:** Feel No Pain 5+. **Price:** Subtract 1 from Battle-shock test results.
- **III — Boon:** Feel No Pain 4+. **Price:** At the start of each battle round, this unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

**Ecstatic Violence**
- **I — Boon:** Re-roll Hit rolls of 1 for melee attacks. **Price:** When declaring a charge or selecting targets for melee attacks, it must include the closest eligible enemy unit where possible.
- **II — Boon:** Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons. **Price:** Subtract 1 from saving throws made for models in the unit.
- **III — Boon:** Its melee weapons gain LETHAL HITS and add 1 to their Strength characteristic. **Price:** The unit has FIGHTS LAST.

**Perfect Sensation**
- **I — Boon:** Its ranged weapons have IGNORES COVER. **Price:** Its ranged weapons must target the closest eligible enemy unit wherever possible.
- **II — Boon:** Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of its ranged weapons by 1. **Price:** Subtract 2" from its Move characteristic.
- **III — Boon:** Its ranged weapons gain SUSTAINED HITS 1. **Price:** The unit has Objective Control 0 and cannot Advance.

**Whispered Secrets**
- **I — Boon:** Once per phase, re-roll one Hit roll, Wound roll or saving throw made for the unit. **Price:** Worsen its Leadership by 1.
- **II — Boon:** Its attacks score Critical Hits on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+. **Price:** The unit cannot be targeted by its controlling player's Stratagems.
- **III — Boon:** Re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1 for its attacks. **Price:** After this unit finishes shooting or fighting, it suffers D3 mortal wounds.

**Thrall of the Dark Prince**
- **I — Boon:** Re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1 for its attacks. **Price:** Worsen its Leadership by 1.
- **II — Boon:** Improve the AP characteristic of its weapons by 1. **Price:** When the unit shoots or declares a charge, it takes a Leadership test before selecting targets. If it fails, the Emperor's Children player chooses its legal targets.
- **III — Boon:** Feel No Pain 5+. **Price:** Possession.

**Possession**

At the start of **your** Movement, Shooting or Fight phase, select one enemy unit with Thrall of the Dark Prince at Level III, excluding Epic Hero units, within 12" of one of your Emperor's Children units. Its controlling player makes a Leadership test for it.
- **Passed:** Reduce its Seduction to Level II.
- **Failed:** Control the unit for one immediate action. In Movement, make one Normal move. In Shooting, shoot once. In the Fight phase, make a Charge move of up to 6" without rolling, then fight once if eligible. For target selection during that action, treat its original army as enemy and your Emperor's Children units as friendly. Use the possessed unit's characteristics and abilities. Your Stratagems and army rules do not apply.

**Possession limitations:** Possession cannot force a disembark, activate a faction rule, spend CP or change mission ownership or scoring. A unit can be possessed only once per battle round. After a failed test, reset its Level to 0 once the action is resolved or if it cannot act.

rules.name: The Sovereign's Will
rules.description:
Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by friendly Emperor's Children Character models.

**Issue Doctrines**
Once per battle round, **at the start of any phase**, each friendly Emperor's Children CHARACTER with **SUBLIME STRATEGIST** on the battlefield can issue one Doctrine to one friendly **Emperor's Children** unit within **12"**. Fulgrim can issue **two Doctrines per battle round**, to two different eligible units; these can be issued in the same or different phases.

The recipient immediately suffers **1 mortal wound**, or **3 mortal wounds** if Stupefied. If it survives, it gains the chosen Doctrine **until the start of your next Command phase**. A new Doctrine replaces any existing Doctrine.

**Doctrines**

- **Decree of Slaughter:** Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have **LETHAL HITS** and **SUSTAINED HITS 1**.
- **Decree of Iron Loyalty:** Models in this unit have a **5+ invulnerable save**.
- **Decree of the Perfect Hunt:** Add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in this unit.

rules.name: Carefully Measured Excess
rules.description:
When a friendly non-Daemon Emperor's Children Infantry, Mounted or Beast unit that is not Stupefied is selected to Advance, charge or fight, or is selected as the target of melee attacks, it can take one drug whose trigger it meets. Take a Leadership test for each dose. Resolve the drug on a pass or fail. On a failure, the unit also suffers 2 mortal wounds and becomes Stupefied.

A unit can have multiple different drugs active. It can take another dose of a drug after its effect expires.

- **Predator's Ichor:** When selected to fight, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of its melee weapons until the end of the phase.
- **Caustic Ecstasy:** When selected to fight, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of its melee weapons by 1 until the end of the phase.
- **Quicksilver Adrenaline:** When selected to Advance or charge, add 1 to its Advance and Charge rolls until the end of the turn.
- **Reflex Narcotics:** When selected as the target of melee attacks, subtract 1 from Hit rolls for those attacks.

rules.name: Unbroken Perfection
rules.description: Re-roll saving throws of 1 for models in friendly Emperor's Children Terminator units.

rules.name: The Art of Suffering
rules.description:
When a friendly Emperor's Children unit is selected to fight, you can give its melee weapons [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] until it finishes making its attacks.

Each time an attack made by a friendly Emperor's Children unit would inflict damage on an enemy unit through Devastating Wounds, prevent that damage and place one Pain Token on that enemy unit for each point of damage prevented. Pain Tokens remain until spent or the unit is destroyed.

**Thresholds of Agony**

- **3+ — Exposed Nerves:** Worsen armour saving throws made for that enemy unit by 1 against attacks made by friendly Emperor's Children units.
- **6+ — Unbearable Agony:** Subtract 1 from Hit rolls for attacks made by that enemy unit. The first time it reaches 6 Pain Tokens each battle round, it must take a Battle-shock test.
- **9+ — Agony Beyond Endurance:** Add 1 to Wound rolls for attacks made by friendly Emperor's Children units against that enemy unit. After a friendly Emperor's Children unit finishes resolving its attacks against an enemy unit with 9 or more Pain Tokens, the attacking unit can make a Normal or Fall Back move, as applicable. Each friendly unit can make this move only once per phase.

**Pain Payments**

- **Nerves Unstrung:** When an enemy unit is selected to fight, you can remove 3 Pain Tokens from it. Until the end of the phase, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of its melee weapons, to a minimum of 1.
- **The Perfect Scream:** At the start of the Fight phase, you can remove 6 Pain Tokens from one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase, it cannot benefit from Fights First or be selected to fight until all eligible friendly Emperor's Children units have fought.
- **Savour the Suffering:** When a friendly unit must take a Leadership test for Fading Euphoria or Pain Brings Clarity, you can remove 2 Pain Tokens from an enemy unit within 6" of it. If you do, the friendly unit automatically fails that test.

**Perfection Through Agony**

After a friendly Flawless Blades unit finishes making its melee attacks, if it placed 6 or more Pain Tokens on its Obsession with those attacks, it becomes Enraptured.

**The Phoenician Prince**

While this model has 1-6 wounds remaining, subtract 1 from its Hit rolls and add 1 to its Wound rolls.

**Master of Excess**

Before the battle, select two different Warband Elixirs for Fulgrim. Their normal effects are always active for him without dosage tests. When he becomes Stupefied, he retains both, gains both Stupefied effects, and also gains the normal and Stupefied effects of a third accessible Combat Elixir. The third choice is not restricted to Warband Elixirs.

**Sovereign of Sensation**

While Stupefied, Fulgrim is not Battle-shocked and cannot become Battle-shocked. He still takes required Leadership and Battle-shock tests and applies other consequences; the automatic-failure rule still applies except at recovery. He cannot take new doses. His Stupefied state ends at the normal next Command-phase recovery even though he is not Battle-shocked.

**Weapon ability: Daemonic Poisons - Serpentine tail**

After resolving attacks made with this weapon, each enemy unit that suffered damage from one or more of those attacks becomes Poisoned until the end of your opponent's next turn. While a unit is Poisoned, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of weapons equipped by its models, to a minimum of 1. Apply this only after saving throws and rules that prevent wounds have been resolved. This effect does not stack with itself; a subsequent application refreshes its duration.

EPIC HERO / ABILITIES

Fulgrim / Continued

**Signature Elixir: Phoenician Ambrosia**

**Once per battle. Activate at the start of either Fight phase; lasts until the end of**

that phase. Fulgrim's daemonic blade attacks score Critical Hits on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+. If Stupefied, once during this activation, when he fights, he can make attacks with both the strike and sweep profiles of his daemonic blades. Resolve the tail only once; this is not another fight activation and grants no additional Pile-in or Consolidation.

**Ordinary doses while lucid**

While not Stupefied, Fulgrim can take multiple different additional ordinary Combat Elixirs using their normal timing and dosage Leadership tests, beyond his two permanent Master of Excess selections. While Stupefied, he cannot take new ordinary doses.

**A Challenge Worthy of Skill**

Each time this model makes an attack that targets a Character, Monster or Walker unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and the Wound roll.

**Duellist's Hubris**

At the start of the Fight phase, if this model is not leading a unit, it has Fights First until the end of the phase.

**Signature Elixir: Duellist's Ichor**

Activate at the start of either Fight phase; lasts until the end of that phase. Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. If Stupefied, their melee attacks also score Critical Hits on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+. Reusable.

**Signature Elixir: The Perfect Moment**

Once per battle. Activate at the start of either Fight phase; lasts until its end. Lucius's melee weapons have [DEVASTATING WOUNDS]. If Stupefied, once in that phase, after his unit has resolved its melee attacks, Lucius can make one additional set of melee attacks. Only Lucius attacks again; no additional Pile-in, Consolidation or bodyguard attacks are granted.

**Leader**

Flawless Blades, Phoenix Guard Terminators.

EPIC HERO / ABILITIES

Lucius the Eternal / Continued

**The Eternal**

Once per turn, during the Shooting or Fight phase, when Lucius is destroyed by an attack made by an enemy unit, the controller of that attacking unit must select one non-Epic Hero Infantry model from that attacking unit, if one exists. Place an ETERNAL marker on that model. At the start of each Fight phase, roll one D6 for the marked model. On a 3+, remove the marker, destroy that model and return Lucius to the battlefield in its former position with D6 wounds remaining. If his base cannot fit exactly, place him as close as possible. He can be set up within Engagement Range of the host's former unit or other enemy units. Lucius returns as a separate single-model unit and is Stupefied and Battle-shocked. Select one Combat Elixir from this codex for his unit, including Signature, Warband, detachment and enhancement elixirs. It gains the normal and Stupefied effects for that state. This does not refresh an expended once-per-battle use. If the host dies before possession resolves, that marker is lost and does not revive Lucius. If the attacking unit contains no eligible host, no marker is placed. Remove the marker before destroying a successfully possessed host so its destruction does not cancel that successful return.

**A Moment of Lucidity**

Once per battle, at the start of a phase, Lucius's unit can ignore Stupefied until the end of the current turn and immediately cease to be Battle-shocked. This explicitly overrides the normal restriction. CHARACTER / ABILITIES

Idol of Sublime Perfection / Continued

**Communion of Excess**

At the end of your Command phase, this model can release Nectar of the Idol. Every friendly Emperor's Children unit excluding Daemons within 6" of this model becomes Stupefied, selecting Nectar of the Idol as its active Combat Elixir instead of another elixir. Do not take dosage Leadership tests for these activations. All other elixir effects end as normal for Stupefied. Units already Stupefied replace their selected elixir with Nectar of the Idol. The usual Stupefied penalties and next Command-phase recovery apply. The effect remains if a recipient subsequently leaves the Idol's range.

**Signature Elixir: Nectar of the Idol**

Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit. If Stupefied, those weapons also gain [CLEAVE 2]. Communion affects every friendly non-Daemon EC unit within range; it is not restricted to Infantry and does not select only one recipient. It is a voluntary release by the Idol, but once released all eligible units in its radius are affected. The Idol dispenses the drug. It does not gain Nectar's benefits itself. Its healing aura and self-heal remain separate abilities and do not require Nectar to be released.

**Bound daemonic body**

This model has the Daemon keyword and remains an Emperor's Children unit. It does not have Combat Drugs and cannot take dosages itself. Its two permanent Warband Elixir effects come only from Bound Excess. Communion of Excess administers Nectar to nearby eligible units; it is not a dosage taken by the Idol. This model does not have Manifestation and is not summoned or Debound through the Legions of Excess rules.

sharedRules.name: The Pursuit of Perfection
sharedRules.description:
**Perfect Execution**

When a friendly Emperor's Children unit is selected to shoot or fight, if it is neither Obsessed, Enraptured nor Stupefied, you can select one eligible enemy unit as its Obsession. Your unit becomes Obsessed.

**Obsessed**

Re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1 for attacks against this unit's Obsession. Each attack must target its Obsession if eligible, and each charge it declares must include its Obsession if eligible. A unit can have only one Obsession.

**Surrender to Excess**

- Immediately after this unit destroys its Obsession with its attacks, it ceases to be Obsessed and becomes Enraptured.
- At the end of the turn, if its Obsession survives, this unit ceases to be Obsessed and becomes Stupefied.
- If its Obsession is destroyed by another source or otherwise removed before this resolves, this unit ceases to be Obsessed.

A unit can be in only one of these states at a time.

**Enraptured**

- Re-roll Hit rolls of 1 for this unit's attacks. If the target is within 12" of the attacking model, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.
- This unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge after Advancing or Falling Back.
- Models in this unit have Feel No Pain 6+.
- Worsen this unit's Leadership characteristic by 1.

**Stupefied**

- Re-roll Wound rolls of 1 for this unit's attacks. If the target is within 12" of the attacking model, you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.
- Models in this unit have Feel No Pain 5+ and Objective Control 0.
- Worsen this unit's Leadership characteristic by 1.
- This unit cannot be targeted by friendly Stratagems unless the Stratagem explicitly permits it.
- Each attack must target the closest eligible enemy unit to this unit whenever possible. Measure between the closest models in the two units. Each charge it declares must include the closest eligible enemy unit.

**Fading Euphoria**

During the Battle-shock step of your Command phase, each friendly Enraptured or Stupefied unit must take a Leadership test. On a pass, it ceases to be Enraptured or Stupefied. On a failure, it remains in its current state.

**Pain Brings Clarity**

When any unit within 6" of a friendly Enraptured or Stupefied unit is destroyed, or an enemy unit within 6" of it fails a Battle-shock test, that friendly unit must take a Leadership test. Measure to a destroyed unit before removing its last model. On a pass, the testing unit ceases to be Enraptured or Stupefied. On a failure, it remains in its current state. Each unit can take this test only once per phase.

sharedRules.name: Manifestation
sharedRules.description:
**Summoning Pool**

Legions of Excess units begin the battle in your **Summoning Pool**. A summoned Attached unit uses **one Ritual**, shares **one Manifestation total** and becomes Debound as one unit.

**Manifestation Capacity**

Greater Daemons have a maximum of **9 points**. Lesser Daemons have a maximum of **6 points**.

**Initial Manifestation**

After paying the Ritual costs and resolving its risks, set up the summoned unit wholly within **24"** of its Psyker and more than **8"** horizontally from all enemy models. Roll for its initial Manifestation using the applicable distance band, up to its capacity.

| Placed wholly within | Initial Manifestation |
|---|---|
| **6"** | **D3+3** |
| **12"** (but not wholly within 6") | **D3+1** |
| **24"** (but not wholly within 12") | **D3** |

**Feeding on Suffering**

Each time a friendly or enemy non-Daemon unit within **6"** of a Legions of Excess unit on the battlefield is destroyed or fails a Battle-shock test, that Legions of Excess unit gains **1 Manifestation point**, up to its capacity. Measure a destroyed unit's range immediately before removing its last model.

**Fading Presence**

At the end of **each phase in your turn**, after any applicable gains that phase, every Legions of Excess unit on the battlefield with Manifestation loses **1 point**. **Furies of Slaanesh** lose this point only at the end of **your Fight phase**.

**Debound**

If a unit has **0 Manifestation points**, it immediately becomes **Debound**. Return its surviving models to the Summoning Pool with their remaining wounds. Debound does not count as destruction.

sharedRules.name: Summoning Rituals
sharedRules.description:
**Lesser Daemonic Ritual — Psychic Level 1**

At the start of a phase in **your turn**, one friendly **non-Daemon Psyker** unit that is not Battle-shocked can attempt a Lesser Daemonic Ritual, spending **1** of its available psychic-level allowance for the battle round. Roll one D6 as a psychic roll. On a **1**, the caster's unit becomes Battle-shocked; regardless of the roll, complete the Ritual if legal. Select a **Lesser** Legions of Excess unit in your Summoning Pool and set it up using the Initial Manifestation rules.

A Psyker can repeat this Ritual while it has psychic-level allowance remaining. A friendly Daemon Psyker can use it only to summon Furies of Slaanesh.

A summoned Lesser unit can charge that turn if eligible.

**Greater Daemonic Ritual**

At the start of **your Charge phase**, select one friendly **non-Daemon Psyker** that **has not performed any summoning Ritual earlier this turn**. Select one Greater Daemon still in your Summoning Pool, then pay **one** of these costs:

- **Sacrifice:** Destroy one **other** friendly non-Daemon Emperor's Children INFANTRY unit within **6"** of the summoning Psyker.
- **Essence:** Select one friendly Legions of Excess unit within **6"** of the summoning Psyker with **at least 3 Manifestation points**. Remove **3 Manifestation points** from it as payment.

Resolve the cost, then set up the Greater Daemon using the Initial Manifestation rules.

A Greater Ritual spends no psychic-level allowance. Each eligible Psyker can perform its own Greater Ritual. A summoned Greater Daemon can charge that phase if eligible.

That unit.

### Effect

Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of your unit's melee weapons by 1.

sharedRules.name: Mercurial Host — Hunting in Packs / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
### When

Fight phase, when a friendly Mercurial unit is selected to fight.

### Target

That unit.

### Effect

Until the end of the phase, add 1 to Wound rolls for your unit's melee attacks targeting an enemy unit within Engagement Range of another friendly Mercurial unit.

sharedRules.name: Carnival of Engines — Feed the Furnace / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
### When

Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Emperor's Children Vehicle unit is selected to shoot or fight.

### Target

That unit.

### Effect

Until the end of the phase, re-roll Wound rolls of 1 for your unit's attacks targeting Battle-shocked units.

sharedRules.name: Carnival of Engines — Revel in the Wreckage / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
### When

After a friendly Emperor's Children Vehicle unit destroys an enemy unit with its attacks.

### Target

That unit.

### Effect

One model in your unit regains D3+3 lost wounds.

sharedRules.name: Carnival of Engines — A Last Catastrophe / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
### When

After a friendly Emperor's Children Vehicle unit with Deadly Demise is destroyed, before rolling for that ability.

### Target

That destroyed Vehicle unit.

### Effect

Its Deadly Demise triggers on a 4+ instead of its normal result.

sharedRules.name: The Flesh Perfected — Surgical Precision / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
### When

Fight phase, when a friendly Emperor's Children Infantry unit with a Surgical Augmentation is selected to fight.

### Target

That unit.

### Effect

Until the end of the phase, your unit's melee weapons have Precision.

sharedRules.name: The Flesh Perfected — Involuntary Convulsions / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
### When

Start of the Fight phase.

### Target

One friendly Emperor's Children Infantry unit with a Surgical Augmentation.

### Effect

Destroy one non-Character model in your unit. If you do, it gains Fights First until the end of the phase.

sharedRules.name: The Flesh Perfected — Aberrant Anatomy / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
### When

Fight phase, after an enemy unit finishes making melee attacks against a friendly Emperor's Children Infantry unit with a Surgical Augmentation.

### Target

That friendly unit, if it lost one or more models to those attacks.

### Effect

The attacking enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

sharedRules.name: The Harmonic Cabal — Psychic Concordance / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
### When

When a friendly Emperor's Children or Legions of Excess Psyker unit uses a non-summoning psychic power, before its psychic roll.

### Target

That Psyker unit.

### Effect

Your unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. If it does, skip the psychic roll and resolve the power.

sharedRules.name: The Harmonic Cabal — Warp Ward / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
### When

After an enemy unit selects targets for a Psychic weapon.

### Target

One friendly Emperor's Children or Legions of Excess unit selected as a target and within 6" of a friendly Emperor's Children or Legions of Excess Psyker.

### Effect

Until the end of the phase, your unit has Feel No Pain 4+ against Psychic attacks and mortal wounds.

sharedRules.name: The Harmonic Cabal — Focused Malice / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
### When

Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Emperor's Children or Legions of Excess Psyker unit is selected to shoot.

### Target

That unit.

### Effect

Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of your unit's Psychic ranged weapons by 1.
